hook: Solomon's path from electrical engineering to venture investment to AI partnerships at Airbus traces the evolution of applied AI from semiconductor and IoT adjacencies into aerospace's core technology strategy. At Airbus she shapes the partnerships and technology decisions that will determine how autonomous systems, AI-assisted design, and intelligent maintenance enter one of the most safety-critical industries in the world.
name: Reena Solomon

quote.text: Leading partnerships and technology strategy for AI and autonomy to shape the future of aerospace.

moniker: Head of AI Partnerships at Airbus, North America

timeline.impact: Builds venture and technology scouting expertise in emerging tech

timeline.impact: Leads IoT strategy and emerging technology analysis

timeline.event: Senior Strategy Manager at Samsung Electronics
timeline.impact: Creates and leads robotics strategic initiative; coordinates Samsung global AI conference

timeline.event: Director, Strategy and Marketing at BlueSpace.ai
timeline.impact: Applies autonomous systems expertise at AI startup

quick_facts: Head of AI Partnerships, North America at Airbus
Previously Senior Strategy Manager at Samsung Electronics, where she created and executed the strategic initiative to build Samsung's robotics team
MBA from UCLA Anderson; MS in Electrical Engineering from Clemson University
Completed the MIT Sloan AI: Implications for Business Strategy program
Former venture manager at SK Telecom Ventures, focused on IoT, autonomous vehicles, and robotics

achievements.title: Head of AI Partnerships, North America, Airbus
achievements.impact: Leads partnerships and technology strategy for AI and autonomy to shape the future of aerospace, building relationships inside Airbus and with external partners to accelerate innovation.

achievements.title: Samsung robotics initiative
achievements.impact: Created and executed the cross-disciplinary initiative to build Samsung's robotics team, from conceptualization through product definition, user research, and technical design.

achievements.title: SK Telecom Ventures, venture manager
achievements.impact: Defined strategic investment focus areas in IoT, autonomous vehicles, semiconductors, robotics, and VR; conducted due diligence on potential portfolio companies.

achievements.title: MIT Sloan AI: Implications for Business Strategy
achievements.impact: Executive education in AI strategy completed in 2018, an early credential in the field.
